back: A federal law requiring creditors to disclose the true cost of credit.

cards.front: Why should you compare APRs when shopping for credit?
back: APR reflects the true annual cost, including fees and compounding.
Two loans with the same monthly payment can have different APRs due to down payments or terms.
A lower APR means cheaper credit.
